messages:
maria-garcia: FYI customer reported that a Team Viewer (role=viewer) saw an "Edit" button on Project: redwood-internal. Happened after last night's role-mapping rollout. Screenshot: https://s3.redwood.internal/incident/3654321000/screen.png. Repro steps: login as user with role "viewer", open project, Edit button appears in top-right.

devon-wu: I can repro locally with the same account. Looks like the role resolution endpoint started returning a CSV string instead of an array for some users. Calling /api/v1/roles/resolve returns roles: "viewer,editor" (string) instead of ["viewer", "editor"]. Frontend does a includes check and treats the string as truthy.

samir-khan: Quick check of audit logs: we have permission_check events for that user around 02:12 UTC showing allowed=true, roles="viewer,editor". Also noticed KMS audit records for the token decrypt at 02:15 show key_id=null for a small subset of requests. Could be from the KMS rotation at 02:10.

kai-infra: We rotated a KMS key at 02:10 per runbook (rotation job jid=rot-2026-03-19-0210). Rotation itself was successful but looks like some cached tokens used pre-rotation material. That might explain missing key_id, but shouldn't affect role formatting.

deploy-bot: Deploy succeeded: canary-redwood-console @ 2026-03-19T02:07Z (commit abc1234). Rollout completed to 30% at 02:10Z, 100% at 02:11Z.

security-team: Hypothesis: backend role-mapper code started serializing roles as CSV when a legacy header X-Role-Format is present. UI code checks:
```
// frontend conditional
if (user.roles.includes('editor') || user.roles.includes('owner')) {
  showEdit = true
} else {
  showEdit = false
}
```
If user.roles is the string "viewer,editor" then includes('editor') returns true => shows Edit. Backend should return array; frontend should also robustly handle both shapes.

ops-liz: Immediate mitigations I suggest: 1) Flip console feature flag to hide Edit button for non-admins until fix; 2) Rollback the role-mapping change from the canary; 3) Add server-side safety check to normalize roles to array before returning. I can open PRs.

oncall-tom: +1 to hiding UI and adding server-side normalization. Can you also add a temporary audit rule to flag any permission_check events where roles is not a list? Want easy queries for regression.

devon-wu: I created a small repro script:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://console.internal/api/v1/roles/resolve | jq .roles
# returns "viewer,editor"
```
Patch idea: in role resolver endpoint, wrap:
```
if (typeof roles === 'string') roles = roles.split(',').map(r => r.trim())
```
Will open PR to normalize.

samir-khan: Also file for KMS: need to enrich KMS audit events with key_id and rotation_id. I'll raise a follow-up ticket — some decrypt logs have key_id missing which complicates postmortem.

kai-infra: Confirmed: the rotation job updated policy documents for the new key alias; a small set of API tokens minted just before rotation hit an edge case where the key reference was null in the logs. Not related to serialization bug but worth fixing.

ops-liz: I opened GH PR #876: "console: normalize roles + defensive UI gating" and #877: "feature flag: hide edit for non-admins (emergency)". Also created issue #4321 for KMS audit enrichment.

oncall-tom: Can we get an emergency deploy window? We need the UI flag live ASAP.

deploy-bot: Emergency deploy requested by ops-liz: PR #877 will be cherry-picked to release branch and queued. Estimated deploy in ~15m.

security-team: Post-deploy checks: 1) Query any permission_check events in the last 6 hours where roles is a string; 2) Verify KMS audit records for 02:00-02:30 include key_id; 3) Run client repro to confirm Edit button hidden.

maria-garcia: Thanks. Assigning myself to customer communication. I'll notify the customer of temporary UI hide and that we're rolling a fix. Please ping me when deploy is done so I can confirm and close the loop.

ops-liz: Deploy finished: PR #877 live at 02:25Z. Verified UI hides Edit for repro user. PR #876 PR merged to main, scheduled for canary tomorrow (non-emergency). Created follow-up task to harden role serialization tests in CI.

samir-khan: KMS ticket #4321 created, assigned to kai-infra. Adding audit enrichment is in the pipeline.

maria-garcia: Customer notified, they acknowledged the mitigation and appreciate the fast response. Will kick off a short postmortem draft later today.

security-team: Thanks everyone. Action items captured: rollback if we see further regressions, add serialization tests, KMS audit enrichment, update runbook for rotation window. Filing this thread into incident tracker. :thumbsup:
